m50t_fixture_cooling.method: Joint module-mean fit to already-used rest steps 4 and 6, driven by recorded chamber temperature, with one constant equilibrium offset. Zero residual heat is the reference scenario, not a measured absence of internal heat.
m50t_fixture_cooling.scenario_interpretation: Range across pre-rest, post-rest and joint fits with declared residual-heat scenarios. Not a confidence interval or universal physical bound.
m50t_fixture_cooling.classification: Used-fixture calibration estimate; transfer to a new assembly is assumed
limitations: One already-exposed fixture, no independent thermal prediction assessment.
Sensor/fixture equilibrium offset and constant internal heat are not separately identified.
Module mean does not identify individual contacts, spatial gradients or core temperature.

source.article: Low-effort determination of heat capacity and thermal conductivity for cylindrical 18650 and 21700 lithium-ion cells
source.locators: Article Table 1, Table 2, Table 9 and Appendix Table A.14; reproduced on PDF pages 60, 61, 68 and 71

m50t_heat_capacity.quantity: Whole-cell lumped heat capacity, not jelly-roll specific heat
m50t_heat_capacity.uncertainty_interpretation: Tabulated intervals and systematic/method estimates are separate quantities. The 5.9 percent simplification example is from a simulated 18650 analysis, not a measured M50T error bound. No universal confidence distribution is inferred.
m50t_heat_capacity.specimen: One investigated 21700 specimen; the paper reports about 96 percent average state of health. No population or ageing law is identified.
m50t_heat_capacity.implementation: Use the 58.5 J/K literature reference as a constant lumped heat-capacity approximation. Source temperature/SOC dependence and sample transfer are evaluated with scenarios, not silently extrapolated as a measured function.
m50t_heat_capacity.fixture: Wind tunnel with two air velocities; thermally insulated surface/terminal sensors. Thermal capacitance is behind an internal resistance; the source's shell-temperature observation is not identical to a single effective-temperature state.
m50t_heat_capacity.cooling_policy: Do not import the source's external thermal resistance as universal room-air cooling. Each fixture or user-declared conductance remains separate.
